# UI

面向前端设计师、产品设计师和前端开发者的中文 UI 风格与设计规则资料库。

Canonical site: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/
Language: zh-CN
Runtime: static HTML with React interactions

## Primary collections

- Styles: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/styles/
- Animations: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/animations/
- Component recipes: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/recipes/
- Full-page templates: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/templates/
- Design resources: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/resources/
- UI prompts: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/ui-prompts/
- Guides: https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/guides/

## Content contracts

- Style details expose identity, palette, AI implementation rules, component implementations, interactive showcase, usage coverage, CSS, design tokens, and exports.
- Interactive showcases are published at `/ui/styles/{slug}/showcase/`.
- Template details and their standalone React pages share the source published at `/ui/templates/{id}/preview/`.
- Code, prompts, CSS, and tokens are readable in published HTML and available through page actions.
- The canonical URL inventory is published at https://luckymaomi.github.io/ui/sitemap.xml.

## Crawling guidance

- Crawl public pages and static assets under `/ui/`.
- Prefer canonical URLs from the sitemap.
- Use static HTML for descriptive content and source text; execute JavaScript for interactive state.
